name: Deploy on tag on: push: tags: - "*" permissions: contents: read jobs: deploy: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - name: Configure SSH env: SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.VPS_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }} SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS: ${{ secrets.VPS_KNOWN_HOSTS }} run: | install -m 700 -d ~/.ssh printf '%s\n' "$SSH_PRIVATE_KEY" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 printf '%s\n' "$SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts chmod 600 ~/.ssh/known_hosts - name: Deploy env: VPS_HOST: ${{ secrets.VPS_HOST }} VPS_USER: ${{ secrets.VPS_USER }} DEPLOY_SHA: ${{ github.sha }} run: | ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 \ -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \ "$VPS_USER@$VPS_HOST" \ "bash -s -- '$DEPLOY_SHA'" <<'REMOTE' set -euo pipefail commit="$1" cd /home/deploy/oucite git fetch --tags origin git reset --hard "$commit" .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput .venv/bin/python manage.py collectstatic --noinput sudo systemctl restart oucite.service REMOTE - name: Remove SSH key if: always() run: rm -f ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 ~/.ssh/known_hosts
